protocol: Every arm starts fresh acoustic and fusion students. A shared pair scorer selects individual intervals within identical speaker/phone slots. Four disjoint candidate pairs when possible; uniform exploration. Proxy reward is a matched one-AdamW-step change in held-out verification loss, not EER and not an implementation of DDS. EER reward compares matched acoustic+fusion branches. Every 50th block additionally follows both branches with the same 1000 uniform acoustic updates and fusion refresh; these lookahead students are discarded, and their delayed EER difference contributes to the teacher reward. The sampled policy branch is always committed, including negative rewards. Hybrid uses two proxy episodes then six EER episodes. Teacher snapshots after 2/4/8 complete episodes are evaluated on fresh student seeds. No test feedback or automatic promotion.
limitations: One teacher initialization per learned arm; multiple student episodes and three deployment seeds do not establish teacher-seed robustness. Existing reward/selection/test pools have been observed previously. Paired local and finite-horizon rewards are not an exact full-training return or per-segment causal value. Ordinary equal-update controls and measured compute are reported; compute-matched superiority requires a separate timed control.
